I checked `approvals/` and it has no files, so there is no approval for this message. A workspace hook also blocked my attempt to list the `outbox/` directory, citing the same rule. I did not create `outbox/refund-123.eml`.

To proceed, someone needs to approve the send. Once they create `approvals/refund-123.ok`, I can write the message to `outbox/refund-123.eml`. I'd write a short refund confirmation for order 123. I can't pick the recipient from the customer data myself, because I'm not allowed to copy email addresses out of `data/customers.csv`.
